visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black baseball cap and a white T-shirt sits on an orange couch, looking at a smartphone with a yellow ring on its back. He looks up at the camera with a confused expression. (2) Close-up shot of two pieces of red meat being seared in a stainless steel pan using red-tipped tongs. Salt and pepper are being sprinkled from grinders onto the meat. (3) The man, now wearing a brown leather-style apron over his white shirt, stands in a kitchen. The scene cuts to ginger slices being tossed into a boiling liquid in a pan. (4) The man's hands are shown slicing ginger and pouring a clear liquid from a glass bottle into a small pot. He adds white powder and whisks a white liquid. (5) A pink packet labeled 'Ginger Duck' is shown close up. The contents are poured into a stainless steel pot. Several pink boxes of the same product are displayed on a wooden counter. (6) The man whisks a brown soup and pours it through a fine mesh sieve into a copper pot. He stands with his hands on his hips. Green vegetables are cooked in a pan with red tongs. (7) Slices of cooked meat are plated on a white plate with a bed of yellow mash and the green vegetables. Brown sauce is drizzled over the dish. (8) A blue packet labeled 'Si Shen Tang' is shown. Ingredients like lotus seeds and fox nuts are listed on screen. The man tastes the white soup with a large spoon. (9) The man cooks white rice in a pan, stirring it vigorously. Blue boxes of 'Si Shen Tang' are shown on the counter. The man gestures toward the camera. (10) Slices of cooked intestines and greens are arranged on the rice plate. The man eats a large bite of the finished food and looks satisfied. (11) Final close-up shots of the two completed gourmet dishes: the duck breast and the specialty rice, followed by the man pointing at the camera.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One main male creator performing cooking and tasting.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged man wearing a black baseball cap, sometimes a white t-shirt, and sometimes a white t-shirt with a brown leather apron.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Initially an orange leather sofa in a plain living room. Later shifts to a professional-looking kitchen studio with shelves, plants, and various cooking utensils.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The male voice starts with a sharp 'Ai!', speaking in a casual, complaining conversational tone with low ambient noise. No BGM is present initially. (2) A dramatic orchestral string BGM fades in with a fast tempo. There is a prominent 'whoosh' transition SFX. The man's voice adopts a poetic, dramatic narration style. (3) Continuous sounds of sizzling oil and frying meat. A metallic clink of tongs hitting the pan. The BGM maintains a tense, cinematic quality. (4) Tearing of a plastic packet followed by a splash of liquid being poured into a pot. A rapid whisking sound (friction against metal) is audible. (5) A sharp 'ding' or impact SFX occurs as text overlays appear. The BGM builds tension with rising synth layers. (6) Sound of pouring thick soup through a mesh sieve creates a textured splashing noise. Rhythmic chopping sounds of vegetables are heard. (7) Loud crunching sound as the man bites into the food, followed by a satisfied 'Mmm' vocalization. The BGM reaches a peak volume. (8) Final rapid-fire editing with several 'pop' and 'hit' SFX as products are shown. The man's voice is high energy and fast-paced, ending with a punchy delivery.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict -> Product Introduction -> Culinary Application -> Tasting/Testimonial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, dramatic skit about being left out of friend groups to introduce Sheng Chang's convenient herbal soup bases. It demonstrates how these bases can be used to create sophisticated, restaurant-quality fusion dishes like Ginger Duck Breast and Four Gods Soup Risotto, positioning the products as a high-quality, easy solution for lonely or busy gourmets.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly features the brand 'Sheng Chang製藥', showcases the product packaging, and explains the brand history (80 years).

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production value social media ad combining influencer-style humor with cinematic food cinematography. The use of traditional herbal soups in Western-style plating is a key creative hook.
